verdict.rationale: Consensus documents an AI-powered Library where users import their own papers from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF or RIS, then search it, "find gaps," and get cited AI responses. That is in-product AI insight over the user's own collection, but how deep the insights and suggestions go on personal data is only described in marketing terms. Most synthesis evidence concerns the public corpus rather than the user's data. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights and suggestions are generated from the user's own library, explicit proactive suggestion features, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Turn your library into a research engine. Import thousands of papers in one click - then search, find gaps, and put your collection to work.
The Consensus Library brings your entire research library into one searchable, AI-powered workspace.
Import from Zotero ... or import from BibTex, PDF, or RIS
Every response includes citations, so you can trace each insight back to the original source.
